description: Implementation of a test task runner for QUIC protocol testing, managing scheduled tasks and timing using a mock clock.

classes.name: TestTaskRunner
classes.description: A mock task runner for testing QUIC protocol code, capable of scheduling, running, and fast-forwarding tasks based on a mock clock.

methods.name: TestTaskRunner::PostDelayedTask
methods.description: Schedules a task to run after a specified delay.

methods.name: TestTaskRunner::PostNonNestableDelayedTask
methods.description: Schedules a non-nestable task to run after a delay.

methods.name: TestTaskRunner::RunsTasksInCurrentSequence
methods.description: Indicates whether tasks are run in the current sequence (always true).

methods.name: TestTaskRunner::GetPostedTasks
methods.description: Returns the list of posted tasks.

methods.name: TestTaskRunner::NextPendingTaskDelay
methods.description: Returns the delay until the next scheduled task.

methods.name: TestTaskRunner::FastForwardBy
methods.description: Advances time by a given delta, running all tasks scheduled within that period.

methods.name: TestTaskRunner::RunUntilIdle
methods.description: Runs all pending tasks until none remain.

methods.name: TestTaskRunner::FindNextTask
methods.description: Finds the next task to run based on scheduled time.
